{{Quote|The next one a' you Juma-heads to try and smuggle a blaster or so help me any sort of military-grade frag weapons into my facility is gonna take a long walk out the airlock! Why? Because in case you forgot, Peragian fuel explodes at high temperatures! '''Peragian Fuel''' was a kind of fuel found only on [[Peragus II]]. It was extremely volatile, and was almost exclusively mined by the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] until its destruction at the hands of [[Darth Sion]] in [[3951 BBY]]. Among its buyers was [[Citadel Station]], which used the fuel to remain in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Telos IV]].
